inputs.text: [excited] He was 13 meters long — as long as a school bus! [amazed] He was as tall as a 4-year-old! And he weighed 2,500 kilos — [serious] as heavy as 5 horses!
[curious] Thirteen meters, but he was pretty skinny, right?
[confident] Very skinny, yes — mostly because of his neck. [amazed] The neck alone is already half his whole length.
